import os
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_json("input/train.json")
test_df = pd.read_json("input/test.json")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Define columns to exclude as features
exclude_columns = [
    "request_id",
    "giver_username_if_known",
    "request_text_title",
    "requester_subreddits_at_request",
    "giver_flair",
    "requester_subreddits_at_retrieval",
]

# Find common numeric columns in both datasets
all_columns_train = set(train_df.columns)
all_columns_test = set(test_df.columns)

numeric_features = []
for col in sorted(all_columns_train & all_columns_test):
    if col not in exclude_columns and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train_df[col]):
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(test_df.get(col)):
            numeric_features.append(col)

print(f"Numeric features count: {len(numeric_features)}")
print(f"Numeric features: {numeric_features}")

# Prepare numeric features for both datasets
X_train_numeric = train_df[numeric_features].fillna(0).values.astype(np.float64)
X_test_numeric = test_df[numeric_features].fillna(0).values.astype(np.float64)

# Vectorize text features
text_col = "request_text_edit_aware"
train_text = train_df[text_col].fillna("").astype(str)
test_text = test_df[text_col].fillna("").astype(str)

text_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    stop_words="english",
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    norm="l2",
)
X_train_text_vec = text_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_text)
X_test_text_vec = text_vectorizer.transform(test_text)

# Combine features
X_train_combined = np.hstack([X_train_text_vec.toarray(), X_train_numeric])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_text_vec.toarray(), X_test_numeric])

y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(float)

# Split for validation (proper hold-out split never seen during training)
X_train_final, X_val_set, y_train_final, y_val_set = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Calculate scale_pos_weight
n_pos = sum(y_train_final)
n_neg = len(y_train_final) - n_pos
scale_pos_weight = n_neg / max(n_pos, 1)

print("\nTraining single XGBoost model...")
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    subsample=0.85,
    colsample_bytree=0.9,
    reg_alpha=0.01,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    min_child_weight=2,
    gamma=0.1,
    tree_method="hist",
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="logloss",
    scale_pos_weight=float(scale_pos_weight),
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    verbose=False,
)
model.fit(
    X_train_final,
    y_train_final,
    eval_set=[(X_train_final, y_train_final)],
    verbose=False,
)

# Get predictions on validation set (never used for training)
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_set)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_set, val_pred)
print(f"\nValidation AUC (hold-out): {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set using trained model
test_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Clip probabilities for numerical stability
test_predictions = np.clip(test_predictions, 0.001, 0.999)

# Create submission file with required columns
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "request_id": test_df["request_id"],
        "requester_received_pizza": np.round(test_predictions, 6),
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print final metric
print(f"\n========================================")
print(f"FINAL MODEL VALIDATION AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")
print(f"========================================")
